_comment: Item definitions. tags power recipes (#tag ingredients) and the recipe browser. stack = max stack size (Minecraft: 64 default, tools 1). material = GameMaterials name placed on use. fuel_ticks = furnace burn time at 20 ticks/s (Minecraft values); empties_to = what stays in the fuel slot / hand after use. food = eaten by holding right click (hunger = half-hearts healed until hunger exists); plants = crop it plants on farmland (data/crops.json); furniture = furniture kind it places (ADR 0022). work = the work piece it places (ADR 0023: firepit, sieve); tag ground_place = right click puts it on the ground (pit kiln, molds); tag fireproof = a dropped stack does not burn up in lava; tool_head + stick = the tool (flint heads also need a #binding, ADR 0030). attack_damage = melee half-hearts; throw = {damage, speed_m}: right click throws it; bag_slots = slots a worn bag adds; empties_to on food = what is left in the hand after eating.

items._note: stage 3 transport: right click a rail to set it down, right click it to ride (W and S roll it, sneak gets off), sneak and right click takes it back (ADR 0100)

items.name: Chest Cart
items._note: stage 3 transport: a minecart with a chest: set on a rail, items in hand go in, an empty hand pushes it down the line to its end, where hoppers empty it; sneak and right click takes it back (ADR 0100)
